Name: Cy's Multiplayer Pause
Author: Cyborg644
Description:
A new and improved multiplayer pause. Pauses the game when all players are in a paused state. This includes menus, while fishing, and talking to NPCs. Additionaly if a single player is on a floor, monsters do not attack while they are in their paused state.

This mod is still under development. It is very likely to contain additional problems. After further troubleshooting, the mod will become open source. If you have any questions or spot a bug, please DM on Discord @Cyborg64 I would love to help and improve the mod.
